verdict.rationale: Quo documents its own number provisioning: local or toll-free numbers per user, plus Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers. That covers getting numbers in at least the US and Canada. Nothing in the evidence shows broader country coverage or any per-country documentation or regulatory requirements stated up front. missing for 10: coverage beyond US/Canada, per-country documentation/regulatory requirements disclosed up front, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front

citations.quote: Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere, with unlimited calls and texts to the US and Canada.
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Set up a business number in minutes
